# @stackline/ndarray-ops@1.0.0

Alexandro.Net documents `@stackline/ndarray-ops@1.0.0`, an independently
maintained, dependency-free compatibility continuation of
`ndarray-ops@1.2.2`.

## Package identity

- Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/ndarray-ops/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/ndarray-ops
- Source: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-ndarray-ops
- License: MIT with upstream runtime and DefinitelyTyped attribution
- Runtime: Node.js 18 or newer; modern browsers
- Production graph: one node, zero runtime, optional, peer or bundled dependencies

## Compatibility

The package preserves the exact 150-key CommonJS operation inventory and adds
native ESM named/default exports, a byte-identical AMD/classic-browser build,
and corrected TypeScript 3.9/current declarations. Valid views retain
rank-zero and empty behavior, arbitrary rank, shape/stride/offset/order
semantics, negative and zero strides, mixed-order 64-cell reverse blocking,
generic get/set side effects, short-circuit reads and shared-buffer clobber
order. Mutating operations return the destination view.

The static implementation uses no `eval` or `new Function`, so it works under
strict Content Security Policy and Node's string-code-generation prohibition.
Malformed metadata is intentionally hardened: non-finite or out-of-range
shape, stride and offset fields, invalid order permutations, invalid dtype and
invalid generic storage fail synchronously.

## Migration

Existing imports can remain unchanged through the exact alias:

`ndarray-ops@npm:@stackline/ndarray-ops@1.0.0`

Downstreams should run their own clean install, tests, types, lint, build and a
layout-specific smoke test. The replacement is independently maintained and
is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mikola Lysenko, scijs or DefinitelyTyped.
